title: Lateral Movement to Network Infrastructure via Pass-the-Hash
id: 8a9d8b1c-1f2e-4d3a-9b4c-5d6e7f8a9b0c
status: experimental
description: Detects lateral movement attempts to critical network infrastructure (firewalls, routers) using pass-the-hash techniques, excluding known Red Team IPs and maintenance windows.

author: SOC Team

    category: security_event
    product: windows
    service: security
detection:

        EventID: 4624
